comment.body:
Thanks for the repeated reports, the diagnostic ZIPs, and your tests on newer builds. The maintainer's review did not identify a Runner fault and specifically suggested checking whether Windows or another updater terminates the process. A second user has also reported daily exits, but their machine has not yet supplied separate diagnostic evidence.

Please provide the next discriminating evidence:

1. Follow the Microsoft Silent Process Exit registry-entry procedure linked in the maintainer comment, enable it for the affected PowerToys process, reproduce the exit, and attach the public-safe result. No additional `/bugreport` is needed unless a maintainer asks for a fresh PowerToys package.
2. Copy the matching Windows Event Viewer Application or Restart Manager details, including the timestamp, terminating/faulting process or module, and code if present.
3. Include the approximate local time of the next exit and whether Windows Update, Office, or another installer was active. If another affected user can reproduce it, please include their own occurrence time and capture separately.

This will distinguish external termination from an internal PowerToys crash or controlled shutdown.
